content: Apply the medication to the affected area as instructed by your physician, typically twice daily for a duration of five days. Avoid using this medication near the eyes, nose, mouth, or vaginal area, or on large areas of skin unless specifically directed by your doctor. You may cover the treated area with a bandage or gauze if needed. Use this medication consistently to achieve the maximum therapeutic benefit. Continue using it for the entire prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Improvement, such as healed or dried sores and reduced redness, should be noticeable within three to four days. Mild side effects, such as burning, stinging, or itching, may occur. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may lead to a new infection, such as a fungal infection. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar concerns. Before using retapamulin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. If you miss a dose, apply it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store the medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
